name: com.aceland.eventdriven
description:
AceLand Event Driven is a zero-dependency Core framework for Unity, providing a type-safe EventBus (interface-based events with source-generated registration) and Signals (reactive values with linkers). Includes an Editor Event Monitor window for live inspection of events, listeners, payloads and raise history.

Please visit our [Git Book](https://aceland-workshop.gitbook.io/aceland-unity-packages/core-packages/event-driven).
